title: Reject model choices that are not on the allowed list
narrative: A triage model returns a team name that was never on the allowed set. The product must treat that as a rejected proposal. Only product judgement policy may unlock the next action — same split as `fangore_refund_verdict`.
implementation:
`DecisionSurface` / `reject_invalid_choice` / `RulesDecisionBackend` in `mechaharness.decision_surfaces` name the decision plane over judge signal types. Surfaces produce signals; they do not execute side effects.

Covers: POL-01.
